text_block_list.text:
I needed a ruler for work, so
when I came out to buy one—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you are a trainer from the academy.
What a coincidence. What did you come to buy?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A tape measure. We're placing a new sofa
in the dorm, so I need it to take measurements.

She took the ruler she had just bought
out of the bag to show me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A ruler!? It's a ruler!!!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent... Dead straight without a single waiver.
Completely different from those floppy tape measures.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll definitely buy a ruler too.
Right now! At top speed!

Before I could stop her, she bolted away.
Still, measuring a sofa with a standard ruler
seems like it'd be pretty tough...

And then, heading into an antique shop
to do the next round of shopping――

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff, gasp... This couch is
way too long to measure with just a ruler!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We need ten more—no, twenty.
I'll go buy what we're missing right away.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And look at this squishy backrest.
There's no way to measure it with a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's shave it straight with a saw or something.
Once it's straight, it'll be way easier to measure with a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
First, we need a handsaw.
A shop around here that sells handsaws would be—
Seeing her look ready to run off and buy a saw at any second, I hastily stopped her.
choice_data_list: Let's buy a tape measure after all!

text_block_list.text: I convinced Calstone Light O that if we just pick a straight sofa from the start, we won't need to use a saw.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, that is an excellent idea.
You are entirely correct.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at that sleek, boxy sofa!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer. Every single side is perfectly straight.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want that one! I want that one!
I WANT THAAAT OOOONE!!
choice_data_list: Got it! I get it, so please calm down...!

text_block_list.text: After calming her excitement over the perfectly straight sofa and managing to measure it with a ruler, we successfully purchased the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However, just as I said before, tape measures are squishy, bendy, and wobbly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When we have a perfectly good ruler, don't you
think it feels improper to measure with something like that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'd at least hate that.
I want to measure it with a ruler no matter what.
After persuading Calstone Light O, I bought another tape measure from the shop earlier and managed to take the measurements somehow.
